answer: Ephemeral cryptographic puzzle gating. Every participating agent must solve a distinct math problem whose unique solution requires decrypting a fresh cipher broadcasted through a constrained network inlet. This forces the sender to commit substantial compute time and bandwidth per registration, serving as a beacon like a lonely lantern in the dark. An attacker scaling up fake nodes faces exponentially rising hardware costs and latency bottlenecks that make mass sybil creation economically unviable.
